basics.name: Run Wang
basics.summary: Computer Science Ph.D. student specializing in 3D computer vision, AI security, and mobile/edge computing, with experience spanning research, ML systems, and production software engineering. Published/accepted work in CVPR, IEEE INFOCOM, and IEEE/ACM IWQoS.

highlights: Developed and maintained C#/.NET, JavaScript, and SQL Server features for legacy-to-modern application migration, preserving data integrity across production workflows
Optimized SQL Server query performance using stored procedures, indexing, and execution-plan analysis, reducing query latency by more than 50%
Supervisors: Dr. Siyu Huang and Dr. Mert D. Pesé
Researching AI security and robustness of autonomous-driving systems, focusing on adversarial vulnerabilities in perception and decision-making pipelines
Designed ML and time-series models for mobile/edge performance optimization, producing two peer-reviewed papers accepted to IEEE/ACM IWQoS 2025 and IEEE INFOCOM 2026
Supervisors: Prof. Kenji Shimada and Dr. Wentai Zhang
Adapted PSPNet, DeepLabV3+, and SketchGNN for component extraction from engineering drawings, achieving 84% overall accuracy on an in-house dataset
Acknowledged in Component Segmentation of Engineering Drawings Using Graph Convolutional Networks
Collected and dynamically traced 80+ Linux malware samples, extracting 14 system-level behavioral features for malware behavior analysis
Built an in-house behavioral dataset from runtime traces to support downstream malware classification and anomaly detection experiments

research.company: RPI-IBM Cognitive and Immersive Systems Lab
highlights: Supervisors: Dr. Jeff Kephart and Dr. Xiangyang Mou
Built a real-time gesture recognition system in C# and Python using Intel RealSense cameras, collecting 600+ gesture samples and extracting skeletal motion features for recognition experiments

education.summary: Concentration: 3D Computer Vision, AI Security and Mobile Computing

education.area: M.S. in Electrical and Computer Engineering (Applied Advanced Program)

projects.name: Cosmospapers Research Assistant Platform
projects.description: Built a RAG-based research discovery platform indexing 54,000+ papers from 15+ top CS conferences with vectorized retrieval and interactive topic exploration. Extracted 150 hierarchical research topics and visualized topic relationships to help users explore papers by research area. Shipped a public demo and GitHub repository, attracting 23 stars.

projects.name: User Recommendation Microservice
projects.description: Built Spark ETL pipelines on GCP Dataproc to preprocess approximately 1 TB of Twitter data for recommendation-system experiments. Deployed cloud-native recommendation microservices using Kubernetes, FastAPI, and Vert.x, achieving 10,000 RPS within a $0.70/hour infrastructure budget.
